description: Jan Haringstraat 1-11 (BAG 1937): the Coppelstockstraat three-axis front with one more window row: 6.1 m red-brown brick pands of four storeys under a dark tiled roof with a box dormer per pand, three equal windows on every upper storey, a wide ground window and the house door against the party wall

match.note: Haringstraat 1-11 (BAG 1937, 3DBAG eaves 11.4-11.6 m): read off the strip sheet; the 9.9 m eaves of 7 are a different front

gutter.note: Haringstraat 1-11 strip: a dark gutter at about 11.5 m under a tile slope with one box dormer per pand; dormers not drawn

door-left.note: the house door (1.1 m, 0-2.3 m) against the party wall under a small canopy at 2.5 m beside a wide ground window; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right

roof.evidence: Treslongstraat 5-59 strip: dark tile plane from the 9.9 m cornice to 12.3 m, roof windows

rhythm.bays: three equal axes on the upper storeys
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pairs: the doors pair across the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors under a canopy, two windows
rhythm.roofline: light cornice band under a dark tiled roof with dormers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-21 at 40 px/m read off the strip sheet (not gridded): three windows per upper storey on three rows, wide ground window, door against the party wall, box dormers

schemaLimits: the box dormer per pand and the two-over-two sash bars are not drawn
the door canopy is not drawn
notes: Palette: type default dark red-brown; placed pands take their trim-normalised strip wall.
